# factory-lang-typescript configuration

Render TypeScript manifests from the workspace composition.

## LanguageOutput

Which language an engine speaks, so forge-factory can route to it.

| Field | Type | Required | Means |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | string | yes | The language name matched against a repo's languages list. |

## RenderInput

Everything an engine needs to decide what to write.

| Field | Type | Required | Means |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dependencies` | map of string | no | Dependency name to version, for this engine's language only. |
| `repos` | array of Repo | yes | Every member, including those in other languages. |
| `root` | string | yes | The workspace root, where cross repo files live. |
| `spec` | Spec | no |  |

## RenderOutput

What an engine decided to write.

| Field | Type | Required | Means |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | array of File | yes |  |
